nodes.author: W01fGirl
nodes.text: @SunilRaina15 @pradhyu78651514 @organicbotanic I think the problem here is that, although HMPV has been around for decades, this time it appears more virulent because of compromised immune systems. We've allowed repeated covid infections that have destroyed our ability to fight off illnesses......

nodes.author: SunilRaina15
nodes.text: @W01fGirl @pradhyu78651514 @organicbotanic No doubt collective immune deficiency due to Covid is a concern

nodes.author: W01fGirl
nodes.text: @SunilRaina15 @pradhyu78651514 @organicbotanic ... So infections that were relatively mild when we were growing up are now battering us. The number of immunocompromised has grown. And with several viruses doing the rounds at the same time, it can be tricky. No need to panic, but it's good to be vigilant.

nodes.author: SunilRaina15
W01fGirl
nodes.text: @SunilRaina15 @pradhyu78651514 @organicbotanic I sincerely hope you're right. And I agree that it's not a new virus. The concern is as to how our immune systems are reacting to it, if what is being seen in China and other places is true.

nodes.author: SunilRaina15
nodes.text:
@W01fGirl @pradhyu78651514 @organicbotanic Let me confess- for past sometime now we r seeing patients with symptom pattern & radiological findings that r seriously different from what we expect & the response to treatment is not as good as it used to be
That’s what covid has done

nodes.author: W01fGirl
nodes.text: @SunilRaina15 @pradhyu78651514 @organicbotanic It must be quite a challenge to narrow down on the right treatment when there are so many uncertainties. Lots of respect for the medical fraternity. Definitely not easy.

nodes.author: SunilRaina15
nodes.text: @W01fGirl @pradhyu78651514 @organicbotanic Medicine is not Science but an art of uncertainity

nodes.text: @SunilRaina15 @organicbotanic I have a doubt on Gujrat case, in that child he gets symtoms, like:  high fever and cold, then he put on ventilator and now he is recovering, so it  can also cause severe illness in some patients, or we have to wait for sometime🤔
